name: What extra steps are required to install an apron-front farmhouse sink?

mainEntity.name: What extra steps are required to install an apron-front farmhouse sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing an apron-front farmhouse sink requires significant cabinet preparation and specialized carpentry support compared to standard sinks. Because these basins sit deep and extend forward, the front face of standard base cabinetry must be cut down, and custom internal framing cleats must be built to hold 100 to 200 pounds of water-filled basin weight. Abraham Becerra and the HH Remodeling team handle this structural finish carpentry directly, ensuring the cabinet frame is structurally reinforced and cleanly trimmed out before plumbing connections are finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Farmhouse sinks require cutting cabinet faces, custom internal framing supports to carry heavy loads, and detailed trim carpentry to achieve a clean, seamless fit.
